title: Evidence attribution + interaction engine + honesty gate

test.evidence: FULL suite: 370 files / 3464 tests passed, 0 failures. New: drill-actions (15), drill-honesty-gate (9), fixer duplicate-id (2).

liveProof.evidence: drill-spotter-capture-e2e (live browser): 0 step-start frames, >=4 step-end frames, phash/console-burst/message-growth intact - attribution fix verified against a real browser, not a mock.

notes: The fixer-evidence claim was PARTLY REFUTED under adversarial investigation: retries push no record (every catch-path push returns), so a same-index retry cannot desync. The reachable hazard is a duplicate stepId from an insert_before patch echoing the failing step's id. Fixed at the root (id re-mint) plus the LAST-match alignment.

Cached-assertion checks bypass vision entirely, so the honesty gate cannot fire for an already-graduated check. Ekoa's 18 behavioural checks therefore had their stale assertion/spec cleared and returned to vision mode as part of the migration.
